cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(cache_lab LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()
option(CACHE_SANITIZE "Enable address and undefined behavior sanitizers" OFF)
add_library(cache_options INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(cache_options INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_options(cache_options INTERFACE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
if(CACHE_SANITIZE)
    target_compile_options(cache_options INTERFACE -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    target_link_options(cache_options INTERFACE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
add_executable(cache_bench bench.cc)
target_link_libraries(cache_bench PRIVATE cache_options)
add_executable(cache_probe tests/probe.cc)
target_link_libraries(cache_probe PRIVATE cache_options)
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME policy_and_benchmark_contracts COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contracts.py" "$<TARGET_FILE:cache_probe>"
    "$<TARGET_FILE:cache_bench>")
add_test(NAME report_and_matrix COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" -m unittest discover
    -s "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests" -p "test_*.py" -v)
